text:
sophia: Quick ops note for the "Scaling Inference" webinar on Tue 7/12 11am PT. Need owners for reg page copy, Zoom ops, recording backups, and lead routing. Keep it tight.
leo: I'll build the reg page. Layout: hero, 3 bullets (what you'll learn), CTA = 'Save my seat'. Capture email, company, role, marketing_consent. Add hidden utm_campaign=scale-launch.
maya: I'll own emails + subject lines. Proposed confirmation subject: 'You're in — Scaling Inference (Jul 12)'. For the replay email I want language that sets an embargo: "Replay available in 24 hours; slides released next business day."
sophia: Embargo rule approved: processing + QC window 24 hours, slides released next business day. We want gated download for 24 hours to collect leads, then public link.
ben: Zoom ops: enable cloud auto-record + local OBS backup on producer machine. Enable live transcript (host toggles during meeting) to produce VTT. We'll also record a separate guest track if presenters dial in.
ops-bot: reminder: to generate SRT/VTT, host must enable "Allow live transcript" during meeting. Cloud recordings produce separate files for each recording type.
leo: Landing page tracking: include hidden field utm_source=organic_social and param for paid cohorts. Will push to Marketo mapping: email, firstname, lastname, company, role, utm_campaign.
maya: Email cadence: confirmation (immediate), 24h reminder, 30m reminder, replay notice (24h), slides link (next business day), nurture (7 days). I'll draft copy and post.
ben: Edit plan: create 3 social clips (30s hook, 60s demo, 45s CTA) + 2 GIFs for ads. I'll need VTT and rough timestamps within 12 hours of the live event.
sophia: Lead routing: MQL if role contains "engineer" OR company_size>50 OR engaged with email>2x. MQL -> SDR queue; others -> product nurture. Include Marketo smart campaign for tagging.
leo: Will share landing link once live. Promo window: 6 business days. Paid cohorts start Wed after page up.
maya: A/B test reminder subject lines on small segment: short vs descriptive. I'll report open rates in dashboard.
ben: Reminder to presenters: wired Ethernet, headset, close background apps, join 20m early for soundcheck. Producer will record an intro slate for trimming.
sophia: Nice. Action owners: leo (landing), ben (recording + clips), maya (emails), sophia (moderation + promos). Rehearsal Mon at 10am PT. Ping here if any blocker. :thumbsup:
